mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message_feedback (user_id, thread_id, message_id, rating, reason_code, comment, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ( #{userId}::uuid, #{threadId}, #{messageId}, #{rating}, #{reasonCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{comment,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, now(), now() ) ON CONFLICT (user_id, message_id) DO UPDATE SET thread_id = EXCLUDED.thread_id, rating = EXCLUDED.rating, reason_code = EXCLUDED.reason_code, comment = EXCLUDED.comment, updated_at = now()
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM message_feedback WHERE user_id = #{userId}::uuid AND message_id = #{messageId}
mapper.select: SELECT message_id, rating, reason_code FROM message_feedback WHERE user_id = #{userId}::uuid AND thread_id = #{threadId} ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
SELECT count(*) FROM message_feedback f WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT f.user_id::text AS user_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(us.display_name, ''), us.username) AS username, f.thread_id, f.message_id, f.rating, f.reason_code, f.comment, f.created_at FROM message_feedback f LEFT JOIN users us ON us.public_id = f.user_id WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY f.created_at DESC, f.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.rating = 'UP') AS up_count, count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.rating = 'DOWN') AS down_count FROM message_feedback f WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT f.reason_code, count(*) AS total FROM message_feedback f WHERE f.rating = 'DOWN' AND f.reason_code IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY f.reason_code ORDER BY total DESC, f.reason_code ASC

SELECT f.user_id::text AS user_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(us.display_name, ''), us.username) AS username, f.thread_id, f.message_id, f.rating, f.reason_code, f.comment, f.created_at FROM message_feedback f LEFT JOIN users us ON us.public_id = f.user_id WHERE 1 = 1
ORDER BY f.created_at DESC, f.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
